interpretation: Identity and located teaching relationships are separated from automatic title matches and exact text mentions. A term appearing in a source is not proof of its definition, endorsement, influence, or logical dependence.
authorship: Antlerboy is a mixed public-work library. Chosen Path is Benjamin Taylor’s writing site. SysCoi is a curated community archive: a post or link is not an assertion that Benjamin authored the underlying material.

research_collection.status: 959 files have readable text extracted at this release snapshot; 55 distinct publications have matched public bibliographic identities. Other files require extraction, identity reconciliation, or restrictions review. Text indexing is not a claim of full scholarly reading. Unindexed and binary files remain outside the inventory completeness claim.
